Name: Netophah
Description: A village near Bethlehem that gave David two of his mighty men, Maharai and Heleb the Netophathites, and whose sons returned from exile with Zerubbabel and are counted in Ezra and Nehemiah.
BiblicalSignificance: Netophah is a village of soldiers and returnees: its men fought for David and its children came home from Babylon.
KeyScriptures: 2 Samuel 23:28-29; 1 Chronicles 9:16; 1 Chronicles 11:30; 1 Chronicles 27:13; 1 Chronicles 27:15; Ezra 2:22; Nehemiah 7:26
RelatedPeople: Maharai the Netophathite; Heled, Son of Baanah
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
